info.title: UniVerse API
info.description: Every error is `{ error: { code, message, requestId } }`. Unsafe methods need the `X-CSRF-Token` header from /api/auth/login or /api/auth/me.

get.summary: Readiness: database reachable and file storage writable

post.summary: Sign in. Sets the httpOnly session cookie; returns the CSRF token.
post.description: Exempt from the CSRF token (there is no session yet) but requires application/json and an allowed Origin. Five failures for one email lock it for 15 minutes, whether or not the account exists.
New password: 12–256 characters, different from the current one, not containing the email local part. Signs out every other session.

get.summary: Modules the signed-in role may use, in navigation order
User, unread count, latest 5 events and every visible module summary
get.description: Each module entry is `ok` (with `data` matching that module's summary schema), `error` or `timeout` (1.5 s). One module failing never fails the response.

404.description: Not found (also returned for resources the user may not see)

get.description: Named events: `activity` (an ActivityEvent) and `unread-count` (`{ count }`). Send `Last-Event-ID` to replay up to 100 missed events.

get.summary: List users (admin): search by name or email, filter by role and active

post.summary: Create a user with a temporary password (shown once)

patch.description: Admins cannot demote or deactivate themselves; the last active admin can never be removed (409). Deactivating signs the user out everywhere.

post.summary: Upload one file for a registered purpose (e.g. hub.resource)
post.description: multipart/form-data with exactly one file part and no other fields. The type is detected from the bytes and checked against the purpose; size and per-user quota are enforced while streaming.
